items.title: Responsive overflow, clipped tablet builder and form sizing
before: Home document 463–473px wide at 320–414px viewport; tabs overflow
Builder right panels extend to 1038px at 820–1024px and are clipped
changes: Mobile home tabs contained in their own scroll rail below heading
Builder uses one column through 1050px; existing small-screen rules moved instead of duplicated
Product metadata/prices can wrap; specification values break long tokens
Mobile form controls use at least 16px and text scaling is predictable
checks: 7 browser tests passed: 10 routes at 320,360,390,414,768,820,1024px; right builder panels fit; forms >=16px
Full frontend check passed: 146 tests, formatting, ESLint, TypeScript and production build

items.title: Keep catalog position and overlay geometry during async loading
before: Menu lazy fallback changed header height 56→77→56px
changes: Catalog sort, density and filter updates preserve scroll; refresh indicator occupies a permanent toolbar slot
One fixed dismissible overlay loader for lazy cart/menu replaces in-flow paragraphs
Shared reference-counted body lock supports overlapping overlays and restores original padding/overflow
Native modal uses the same lock; mobile filter sheet fits the current viewport
checks: 149 frontend tests, TypeScript, formatting, lint and production build passed
10 browser tests passed including delayed menu/cart imports, Escape cancellation, unchanged header height, stable scroll and card top during/after delayed catalog refresh
Both overlapping-lock release orders and StrictMode are covered

items.title: Reserve the home product rail and prevent autonomous touch scrolling
before: Lazy rail inserts about 238px while scrolling; measured shift 0.0901
changes: Home rail reserves card geometry plus the existing 68px carousel/button footprint across loading, error and empty states
Section placeholders reuse the existing section-card grid during client navigation without fake names or links
Gallery image and broken-image fallback share one fixed responsive media box; card visuals cannot shrink in flex layout
Carousel autoplay is disabled for coarse pointers; favorite/compare actions are visible without hover
Long product values/prices wrap within their containers
checks: 153 frontend tests and full frontend static/build checks passed
12 mobile browser tests passed including delayed home products and broken-image geometry at 390px
Mouse, touch and reduced-motion autoplay behavior covered by three unit cases

items.title: Prevent late font replacement from changing visible text geometry
before: Slow mobile catalog has 0.1057 layout shift from late text reflow in public fallback
changes: Google Fonts use display=optional; slow cold visits retain fallback fonts for this navigation instead of repainting visible text
Expanded regression checks cover populated collections, basket, checkout, filters, long product values and maximum prices
checks: Full frontend check passed: 153 tests, Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and production build
19 Chromium mobile browser checks passed across 11 routes and 7 viewport widths
WebKit passed 18 of 19 checks; the remaining narrow checkout overflow is tracked separately as M05

items.title: Constrain checkout intrinsic widths in WebKit on narrow phones
before: WebKit checkout form 337.89px wide in a 320px viewport; document 352px wide
changes: Checkout grid and form explicitly allow their track to shrink, so WebKit does not expand the page from intrinsic form width
checks: 19 mobile checks passed in Chromium and WebKit, including populated checkout at 320, 390 and 768px
Full frontend check passed: 153 tests, Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and production build

items.title: Keep product-rail tabs readable at narrow desktop and tablet widths
before: The first rail tab could shrink and wrap its label at tablet widths
changes: Rail-tab labels keep their intrinsic width and never wrap; phones retain a contained horizontal tab rail
checks: 19 mobile checks passed in Chromium and WebKit across 20 public routes and widths 320–1024px
Visual check at 810, 821 and 1024px confirmed one-line labels and no page overflow

items.title: Keep home product cards visible while a new rail selection loads
before: Changing a rail tab removed the current cards and replaced them with a loader before the next response arrived
changes: The rail query retains the displayed cards until the next selection has loaded
checks: Delayed-response regression check passed in Chromium; the original card kept the same vertical position
Equivalent WebKit probe passed at 390px with no horizontal overflow
